scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site
scripts.test:site: npm run build:site && node --test site/tests/site.test.mjs && node site/tests/browser.mjs
scripts.test:claims: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site && node --test site/tests/claims.test.mjs
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && npm run test:site && npm run test:claims
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
